checks: A real mobile proposal stores complete scope, exact decimal budget and an explicitly chosen historical file; project/current budget remain unchanged.
Editing appends an immutable revision; the original request is explicitly revised to the new full proposal without silent resubmission or inherited approval.
Original preview/submission and an independent reviewer approve the exact revised payload; approval itself changes neither project nor current budget.
Separate human scope/budget attestations and fresh interactive MFA implement the exact approved revision; actual project, implementation record and current budget are reconciled.
The explicit keep mode sends null and a separate approved/implemented change retains the exact original budget identity and total.
Explicit empty replacement sends [], activates a zero-line budget only after approval and implementation, and retains the actual superseded predecessor in currency/state history.
A deliberately incomplete real-write response keeps text/reason, blocks replay and never announces success; actual source reads confirm exactly one created proposal.
A real project-version conflict preserves text and blocks commands; explicit reread resets basis/attestations, saves a fresh revision and paginates immutable historical content.
A controlled 403 refresh removes all cached change/history details and write controls instead of showing stale protected data.
An actual ownership transfer and viewer membership remove create/edit/prepare controls, including direct form routes, after fresh interactive login.
